## Choose a process

Compare processes such as laser cutting or engraving, 3D printing, vinyl cutting, and hand fabrication.

## Release to build

Before using fabrication equipment, show that the file has correct dimensions, appropriate geometry, a suitable material, and the required safety preparation.

## Inspect the result

Measure, photograph, and evaluate the fabricated object. Differences between the digital design and the physical result are useful evidence for the next NICE cycle.
